text: Come on – Everybody's doing it.
translation: 来吧——大家都在这么做。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 口语祈使句 + 破折号分句
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Come on; Everybody's doing it
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: Come on / Everybody's doing it

text: That whispered message, half invitation and half forcing, is what most of us think of when we hear the words peer pressure.
translation: 这种半是邀请、半是逼迫的耳语，正是我们大多数人一听到“同辈压力”这个词时脑海中浮现的画面。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主系表复合句 (同位语修饰主语 + 表语从句 + 时间状语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: That whispered message is what most of us think of
subordinateClauses: 插入语/后置同位修饰: half invitation and half forcing
表语从句: what most of us think of
时间状语从句: when we hear the words peer pressure
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: whispered message / think of A when B / peer pressure

text: It usually leads to no good -- drinking, drugs and casual sex.
translation: 它通常没有好结果——酗酒、吸毒、随便的性关系。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 简单句 + 破折号列举同位语
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: It usually leads to no good
subordinateClauses: 破折号列举解释: drinking, drugs and casual sex
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: lead to no good / casual sex

text: But in her new book Join The Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.
translation: 但蒂娜·罗森伯格在新书《加入俱乐部》中主张，通过她所说的“社会疗法”，同辈压力也可以成为一种积极力量；在这种疗法中，组织和官员借助群体动力，帮助个人改善生活，甚至有可能改善世界。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 转折复合长难句 (宾语从句 + 介词宾语从句 + 非限制性定语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force
subordinateClauses: 宾语从句: that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure
介词宾语从句: what she calls the social cure
非限制性定语从句: in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics... (修饰 the social cure)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: contend that / positive force / the social cure / group dynamics

text: Rosenberg, the recipient of a Pulitzer Prize, offers a host of examples of the social cure in action: In South Carolina, a state-sponsored antismoking program called Rage Against the Haze sets out to make cigarettes uncool.
translation: 罗森伯格曾获普利策奖，她列举了大量社会疗法付诸实践的例子：在南卡罗来纳州，一项由州政府发起、名为“对抗烟雾”的禁烟项目，力图让吸烟变得不再“酷”。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 简单句 (插入同位语 + 冒号展开举例说明)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Rosenberg offers a host of examples of the social cure in action
subordinateClauses: 同位语: the recipient of a Pulitzer Prize
后置定语: called Rage Against the Haze (修饰 program)
不定式目的: to make cigarettes uncool
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: the recipient of / a host of / in action / state-sponsored / set out to

text: In South Africa, an HIV-prevention initiative known as LoveLife recruits young people to promote safe sex among their peers.
translation: 在南非，一项名为“关爱生命”的艾滋病预防计划招募年轻人，在同龄人中推广安全性行为。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 简单句 (过去分词短语作后置定语 + 主谓宾 + 不定式补足语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: an HIV-prevention initiative recruits young people to promote safe sex among their peers
subordinateClauses: 后置定语: known as LoveLife (修饰 initiative)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: HIV-prevention initiative / recruit sb to do sth / among their peers

text: The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer.
translation: 这一理念看起来颇有前景，罗森伯格本人也是一位目光敏锐的观察者。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 并列句 (and连接两个主系表分句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: seem promising / perceptive observer

text: Her critique of the lameness of many public-health campaigns is spot-on: they fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits, and they demonstrate a seriously flawed understanding of psychology.
translation: 她对许多公共卫生宣传活动效果不佳的批评十分准确：这些活动未能利用同辈压力来促进健康习惯，而且显示出其对心理学的理解存在严重缺陷。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主系表结构 + 冒号解释并列分句
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Her critique of the lameness of many public-health campaigns is spot-on
subordinateClauses: 并列分句1: they fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits
并列分句2: they demonstrate a seriously flawed understanding of psychology
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: critique of the lameness / spot-on / fail to mobilize / seriously flawed

text: "Dare to be different, please don't smoke !" pleads one billboard campaign aimed at reducing smoking among teenagers, —teenagers, who desire nothing more than fitting in.
translation: “敢于与众不同，请不要吸烟！”——一项旨在减少青少年吸烟的广告牌运动如此呼吁，可青少年最渴望的恰恰就是融入群体。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 倒装直接引语 + 分词后置定语 + 非限制性定语从句
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: "Dare to be different..." pleads one billboard campaign (完全倒装)
subordinateClauses: 后置定语: aimed at reducing smoking among teenagers (修饰 campaign)
非限制性定语从句: who desire nothing more than fitting in (修饰 teenagers)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: Dare to be different / plead / aimed at / desire nothing more than / fit in

text: Rosenberg argues convincingly that public health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers, so skilled at applying peer pressure.
translation: 罗森伯格令人信服地指出，公共卫生倡导者应向广告商学习，因为后者极其擅长运用同辈压力。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (宾语从句 + 形容词短语作后置定语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Rosenberg argues convincingly that...
subordinateClauses: 宾语从句: that public health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers
后置定语: so skilled at applying peer pressure (形容词短语修饰 advertisers，表原因特征)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: argue convincingly that / ought to / take a page from / skilled at

text: But on the general effectiveness of the social cure, Rosenberg is less persuasive.
translation: 但在社会疗法的总体成效问题上，罗森伯格的论证就没那么有说服力了。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 转折主系表简单句 (介词状语前置)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Rosenberg is less persuasive
subordinateClauses: 介词状语: on the general effectiveness of the social cure
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: general effectiveness / less persuasive

text: Join The Club is filled with too much irrelevant detail and not enough exploration of the social and biological factors that make peer pressure so powerful.
translation: 《加入俱乐部》一书充斥着过多无关细节，却没有充分探讨那些使同辈压力如此强大的社会和生物因素。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (并列介词宾语 + 定语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Join The Club is filled with too much irrelevant detail and not enough exploration...
subordinateClauses: 定语从句: that make peer pressure so powerful (修饰 factors)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: be filled with / irrelevant detail / not enough exploration of / biological factors

text: The most glaring flaw of the social cure as it's presented here is that it doesn't work very well for very long.
translation: 书中所呈现的社会疗法最明显的缺陷是：它的效果既不算好，也维持不了多久。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (方式状语插入 + 表语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: The most glaring flaw of the social cure is that it doesn't work very well for very long
subordinateClauses: 插入方式从句: as it's presented here
表语从句: that it doesn't work very well for very long
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: glaring flaw / work very well for very long

text: Rage Against the Haze failed once state funding was cut.
translation: “对抗烟雾”一旦州政府停止拨款便宣告失败。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (once引导条件/时间状语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Rage Against the Haze failed
subordinateClauses: 时间/条件从句: once state funding was cut
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: failed once state funding was cut

text: Evidence that the LoveLife program produces lasting changes is limited and mixed.
translation: 能证明“关爱生命”项目带来持久改变的证据既有限，又不一致。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (同位语从句 + 主系表)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Evidence is limited and mixed
subordinateClauses: 同位语从句: that the LoveLife program produces lasting changes (解释 Evidence)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: Evidence that ... is limited and mixed / lasting changes

text: There's no doubt that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior.
translation: 毫无疑问，我们所处的同龄人群体对我们的行为有着巨大影响。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 固定句型 + 同位语从句
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: There's no doubt
subordinateClauses: 同位语从句: that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: There's no doubt that / exert enormous influence on

text: An emerging body of research shows that positive health habits —as well as negative ones —spread through networks of friends via social communication.
translation: 新兴的研究表明，健康的习惯——以及不健康的习惯——都会通过社交往来在朋友网络中传播。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (宾语从句 + 插入比较短语 + 方式状语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: An emerging body of research shows that positive health habits spread through networks of friends via social communication
subordinateClauses: 插入语: as well as negative ones
宾语从句: that positive health habits spread through networks of friends via social communication
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: emerging body of research / spread through networks via

text: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.
translation: 这是一种潜移默化的同辈压力：我们会不自觉地模仿自己每天看到的行为。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主系表结构 + 冒号解释从句 + 省略关系代词定语从句
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: This is a subtle form of peer pressure
subordinateClauses: 冒号后主句: we unconsciously imitate the behavior
定语从句: (that/which) we see every day (修饰 behavior)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: subtle form of / unconsciously imitate

text: Far less certain, however, is how successfully experts and bureaucrats can select our peer groups and steer their activities in virtuous directions.
translation: 然而，专家和官员在多大程度上能够挑选我们的同龄人群体、并把他们的活动引向良善的方向，就远没有那么确定了。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 倒装复合句 (表语置于句首以示强调 + 主语从句后置)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: How successfully experts and bureaucrats can select... and steer... is far less certain (正常语序)
subordinateClauses: 主语从句: how successfully experts and bureaucrats can select our peer groups and steer their activities in virtuous directions
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: Far less certain is how ... / select peer groups / steer in virtuous directions

text: It's like the teacher who breaks up the troublemakers in the back row by pairing them with better-behaved classmates.
translation: 这就好比老师把后排的捣蛋鬼拆开，让他们分别和表现较好的同学同桌。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主系表复合句 (定语从句 + 方式状语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: It's like the teacher
subordinateClauses: 定语从句: who breaks up the troublemakers in the back row by pairing them with better-behaved classmates (修饰 teacher)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: break up troublemakers / pair A with B

text: The tactic never really works.
translation: 这种做法从来就没真正奏效过。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 简单句 (主谓结构)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: The tactic never really works
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: tactic never really works

text: And that's the problem with a social cure engineered from the outside: in the real world, as in school, we insist on choosing our own friends.
translation: 这也正是由外部人为设计的社会疗法的问题所在：在现实生活中，就像在学校里一样，我们坚持要自己选择朋友。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 并列复合句 (过去分词后置定语 + 冒号解释 + 比较插入语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: that's the problem with a social cure engineered from the outside
subordinateClauses: 后置定语: engineered from the outside (修饰 social cure)
冒号后独立分句: in the real world, as in school, we insist on choosing our own friends
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: the problem with / engineered from the outside / insist on doing
